DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) YAN QIANG ZHEN, CEO FILED BY PLAINTIFF D & J  TRADE AND TRANSPORT LLC
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-19-2022 - JUDGMENT. (PREVIOUSLY TAKEN UNDER SUMBISSION ON 5-19-22)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF D & J  TRADE AND TRANSPORT LLC IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT TIAN, LU YANG DEFENDANT ZHEN CAI IS DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAY-19-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAY-19-2022 BY CARL CHAMBERLIN. PLAINTIFF D & J TRADE AND TRANSPORT LLC , REPRESENTED BY WEIWEI SU, CFO AND YAN QIANG ZHEN, CEO ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT LU YANG TIAN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ZHEN CAI IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO SERVE DEFENDANT ZHEN CAI WHO PLAINTIFF STATES HAS MOVED BACK TO CHINA. PLLAINTIFF DISMISSES WITHOUT PREJUDICE DEFENDANT ZHEN CAI. BOTH THE PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT ARE ASSISTED WITH ENGLISH TO MANDARIN AND MANDARIN TO ENGLISH TRANSLATION BY COURT CERTIFIED MANDARIN INTERPERTER AIDONG NI. PLAINTIFF DISMISSES DEFENDANT ZHEN CAI. COURT RECESSES AT 2:00 P.M. TO ALLOW PARTIES TO DISCUSS A POSSIBLE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN THE HALL OUTSIDE THE COURTROOM. PARTIES ARE UNABLE TO REACH AN AGREEMENT. HEARING RESUMES AT 2:15 P.M. JUDGE PRO TEM CARL CHAMBERLIN; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
